package.description: A free, extensive and precise OpenEXR image reader and writer for Adobe Photoshop.

en-US.description: A free, extensive and precise OpenEXR image reader and writer for Adobe Photoshop.
en-US.longDescription: Exr-IO is a free, extensive and precise OpenEXR image format reader and writer for Adobe Photoshop. It imports all image channels from OpenEXR file into separate Photoshop layers. Unlike existing solutions, Exr-IO supports all latest OpenEXR standards and specifications.
en-US.name: 3d-io Exr-IO

zh-CN.description: 适用于 Adobe Photoshop 的免费、广泛且精确的 OpenEXR 图像读写器。
zh-CN.longDescription: Exr-IO 是一款适用于 Adobe Photoshop 的免费、广泛且精确的 OpenEXR 图像格式读写器，可以将 OpenEXR 文件中的所有图像通道导入到独立的 Photoshop 图层中。与现有的解决方案不同，Exr-IO 支持所有最新的 OpenEXR 标准和规范。
